historical_record.description: The Recreation and Park Commission approved a $7,500 agreement, paid from an urban beautification grant, with Beckwith & Langsner to design, build and place play apparatus at Bernal Park, the Precita Green.

The Recreation and Park Commission approved conceptual plans to renovate the playground at the east end of Precita Park, with disabled access, a low enclosing fence and new and reconditioned play structures, and new bollards, street trees and seating along Alabama Street as alternates.
The Recreation and Park Commission awarded Golden Bay Construction a $186,500 contract to renovate the children's play area at Precita Park.

The Recreation and Park Commission approved Open Space-funded improvements to the west end of Precita Park and a new pedestrian path giving disabled access from its northwest and southwest corners, estimated at $210,000; the Urban Forestry Division was replacing declining 60- to 70-year-old trees, replanting 8 feet from curbs and retaining walls.
